name: New Era Electronics Co., Ltd
summary: New Era Electronics Co., Ltd, headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan since its establishment in 1984, is a global manufacturer and seller of various printed circuit board (PCB) solutions. The company produces specialized microwave RF PCBs, which are integral components for base station antennas, low noise block (LNB) converters, and other telecommunications equipment. They also offer robust heavy copper, metal core bonding, and copper coin insertion PCBs, essential for demanding applications such as workstation power supplies, base station transceivers, server components, remote radio heads, and small cell devices. Additionally, New Era Electronics supplies standard FR-4 PCBs for computer accessories and general communication and telecom systems. Their product range extends to mixed dielectric PCBs, which are utilized in advanced telecom equipment, power amplifiers, VSAT transceivers, and remote radio heads. Furthermore, the company develops RF automobile PCBs, crucial for modern vehicle safety and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), facilitating functions like blind spot detection, lane departure warning, emergency braking, and both forward and rear collision alerts.
